title: Michigan LARA determination or registration
description: Written determination or registration covering taxicab, limousine, TNC, broker, or other transportation status for a free volunteer-driver program in Michigan.

title: City of Detroit authorization review
description: Confirmation of any City of Detroit permit, registration, or notification required to operate a volunteer transportation program.

title: Commercial / non-owned auto coverage review
description: Broker-confirmed non-owned and hired auto coverage appropriate to volunteer drivers using personal vehicles.

title: General liability and umbrella / excess
description: General liability plus umbrella or excess limits appropriate to the pilot's exposure.

title: Volunteer accident coverage
description: Coverage for volunteers injured while performing platform activity.

title: Abuse and molestation coverage
description: Required before any transport of minors is enabled.

title: Cyber / privacy and D&O coverage
description: Cyber and privacy liability plus directors and officers coverage as applicable to the operator.

title: Written driver personal-auto requirements and exclusions
description: Written confirmation of the minimum personal auto limits drivers must carry and the exclusions that apply to volunteer community transportation.

title: Attorney-approved rider, guardian, driver, organization, privacy, consent and safeguarding documents
description: Every LegalDocument row must reach review_status attorney_approved before this gate can close.

title: Background-check vendor and adverse-action process
description: Signed vendor agreement plus a documented FCRA-compliant adverse-action and dispute process.

title: Motor-vehicle-record and recurring monitoring process
description: Documented MVR pull cadence, eligibility policy, and continuous or annual re-check process.

title: Child safeguarding, mandated reporting, driver training and incident response
description: Written safeguarding policy, mandated-reporter training, and a tested incident-response runbook.

title: Child-restraint equipment and inspection process
description: Michigan-compliant restraint inventory, fitting guidance, and inspection cadence.

title: Payment, tax reporting, volunteer classification and tip policy
description: Counsel review of worker classification, TNC status, tax reporting, and any tip policy before donations or tips are enabled.

title: Privacy and security review, retention schedule, breach response, vendor agreements
description: Completed privacy review, published retention schedule, tested breach-response plan, and signed vendor DPAs.

title: Accessible support channel, emergency phone coverage, outage procedures
description: Staffed phone coverage across service hours, an accessible support channel, and a rehearsed outage fallback.

title: Pilot partner memorandum of understanding
description: Signed MOU with the pilot resource partner covering exact location, hours, participant communication, and escalation contacts.
